GeoGuessr Resource Platform with maps, quizzes and more. # GeographyHelp - Comprehensive GeoGuessr Resources with maps, quizzes & more. 🌎 GeographyHelp is your ultimate resource hub for mastering GeoGuessr with country-specific data and graphics, interactive maps, a wide range of quizzes and more. Use Solve to pinpoint countries based on in-game clues. Elevate your geography skills today! I'm excited to introduce GeographyHelp (), a platform to boost your geographical knowledge and enhance your GeoGuessr skills! 🌎 Whether you're a GeoGuessr player or just love geography, GeographyHelp has the tools to elevate your experience. 🏠 **Home** – An interactive resource table built for flexibility and readability. Use various customization options, such as toggling visibility or reordering columns, grouping by characteristics, filtering by continent, and more. Use the search function to instantly find countries and explore their unique characteristics. 🗺️ **Maps** – Explore a wide range of detailed datasets on our interactive world map. Navigate with zoom, pan, and theme options to tailor the map to your interests. 🎮 **Quiz** – Enhance your geographical knowledge with our diverse quiz collection! There are two main types of quizzes: *Identify the Country*, where you select the country that matches the given clue, and *Identify the Clues*, where you choose the correct clues for the highlighted country. Most quizzes offer a Twitch integration option, allowing chatters to participate in the quiz with the streamer. 🕵️ **Solve** – When you’re stuck during a GeoGuessr round, use the Solve subpage to identify the country based on observed elements. Just select what you see in the Street View image, and a list of probable countries will be shown. 📱 Every feature is mobile-optimized, so users can enjoy quizzes, tools, and learning resources on the go, whether traveling or away from their desk. If you're as passionate about geography and GeoGuessr, I'd love for you to join us on this journey! @ihuzaifashoukat I find the homepage - interactive and dynamic grid to be the most useful. Its really intuitive and provides a fast way to get access to data user needs by utilizing search, filters,, grouping and more... I have a lot of friends to whom I'll recommend GeographyHelp.
